title: POUR OUT
YOUR HEART
end: The Midnight Watch — stand in prayer at midnight
stock_queries: silhouette of ancient stone watchtower under starlit night sky
glowing oil lamp on wooden table in dark sanctuary
distant moon reflecting on calm midnight lake
deep velvet night sky with slow moving stars
steeple silhouette against dark blue twilight
dimly lit prayer chapel empty wooden benches
breathtaking starry nebula in deep midnight sky

scenes.a: The heavy burden you are carrying in the silence of this room is finally being seen.
Arise, cry out in the night: in the beginning of the watches pour out thine heart like water before the face of the LORD:
lift up thy hands toward him for the life of thy young children, that faint for hunger in the top of every street.
Lord, in this hour of deep shadow, we bring our exhausted spirits and our aching needs.
You see the hunger and the fragility within our walls that we cannot fix alone tonight.
We trust that your presence is the water that refreshes our dry and weary souls today.
Please subscribe to walk with us as we stand in prayer at this midnight hour.
